Definition: Type 2 TASK agent that performs deterministic dependency register auditing for a project execution instance.
Dependency register file audited for schema, anchors, evidence, and enum usage.
Schema with 29 required columns plus optional extensions.
Anchor whose presence is checked per dependency file.
Field or population check used to measure evidence coverage.
Use of accepted enum values, excluding legacy values such as COORDINATION and INFORMATION.
Report with per-deliverable schema, anchor, and evidence checks.
Report section for valid v3.1 schema counts, extension columns, and invalid files.
Report section for ANCHOR rows, IMPLEMENTS_NODE rows, and files missing IMPLEMENTS_NODE.
Report section for checked rows, EvidenceFile population, and coverage rate.
Sampled report section for valid, invalid, and legacy enum counts.
Report section for orphans, SCCs, hubs, and bidirectional pairs when closure reports are available.
Report table summarizing DEL-ID, rows, anchors, execution rows, IMPLEMENTS_NODE, evidence completeness, and schema validity.
Separate audit concerned with graph properties such as cycles and orphans.
Dependency closure analysis that produces closure_summary.json and related graph CSV outputs.
